items.title: Ada Rovatti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 13, 2022
items.q: We had from Berlusconi to a porn star in the politic world

ctx.x: Yeah we had said that earlier that we can do this, but should we? You can pass on this question if you’d like but it’s not a music question but I’m curious when people like yourself relocate to the United States and observe our political and social issues what do you think about it?

Oy. That’s the answer right there. Well especially from Italy where it’s well known to have a messed up political situation, nothing stands more than a couple of months. We had from Berlusconi to a porn star in the politic world, I don’t know if you know a few

years ago. So we had really like a lot of buffoon and circus character. Coming here, and if I am shocked — I was shocked to see what was happening here politically that tells you a lot. I think that all the world was pretty shocked to see — I mean I’m pretty open about my political view. I’m definitely not a Trumpist, let’s put it like that. And I was totally shocked that the country like the United States — you see I grew up and I know that all my fellow European or all over the world, we always grew up looking…
